note: Captured once from the published effect-dynamodb@1.40.0 and @effect-dynamodb/schema@1.40.0, installed outside the repo and run by a scratch script against DynamoDB Local. Each entity (Beside plain, Retained with versioned: { retain: true }, Unique with a unique constraint on a#b) holds an optional model field named a#b stored as `stored`, beside a sparse map g stored under the prefix a, so the map's entry b is the attribute a#b; each is seeded with { id: 'a', 'a#b': 1, g: { b: 5 } }. For each operation naming the entry through the map (.entry() in a condition, .set of the map, removeEntries, a path operation on segments .entry() built), its outcome, every request it sent, whole and in order (reads included), the row after it and what get read back; the table's name is replaced by <table>, UUIDs and timestamps by <token> and <time>. Never regenerate it: it is the record of what 1.40.0 did.
